chapters.title: Chapter 1: First Day on Dalal Street
chapters.subtitle: The Fundamentals of Equity Markets
chapters.description: Learn what a share of stock represents, how stock exchanges operate, and how to execute your first order inside the Bombay Stock Exchange.

objectives.title: Meet Your Mentor Devendra
objectives.desc: Speak with senior investor Devendra outside the BSE building on Dalal Street.
objectives.lesson: A share represents fractional ownership in a real operating business. Stock exchanges provide an organized, regulated marketplace where buyers and sellers can trade shares transparently.

objectives.title: Enter the BSE Trading Floor
objectives.desc: Walk through the historic Phiroze Jeejeebhoy double doors into the Bombay Stock Exchange floor.
objectives.lesson: Trading regulations mandate that orders can only be executed while physically present on an authorized exchange trading floor.

objectives.title: Consult Floor Broker Rajesh Kumar
objectives.desc: Speak with Senior Broker Rajesh Kumar near the trading pit.
objectives.lesson: Stock price reflects the equilibrium where current supply meets demand. Company market valuation is calculated as share price multiplied by total outstanding shares.

objectives.title: Inspect the Electronic Ticker Console
objectives.desc: Walk over to the Sensex order console in the trading pit and inspect live order books.
objectives.lesson: Stock charts display price discovery over time. Green candles denote price gains during a period, while red denotes selling pressure.

objectives.title: Execute Your Guided First Trade
objectives.desc: Open the Trading Terminal [T] and buy at least 5 shares of Monsoon Global Goods (CHAI).
objectives.lesson: Congratulations on executing your first equity trade! You now own a fractional share of Monsoon Global Goods.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Investigate the Company
chapters.subtitle: Fundamental Analysis & Corporate Intelligence
chapters.description: Visit the headquarters of Monsoon Global Goods on Dalal Street. Interview key department leads, inspect financial records, record clues in your journal, and build a research-backed investment thesis.

objectives.title: Enter Monsoon Global Goods HQ
objectives.desc: Walk down Dalal Street to Monsoon Heritage Building and step inside.
objectives.lesson: Fundamental analysis involves investigating corporate operations, supply chains, management quality, and financial balance sheets.

objectives.title: Interview Master Blender Anand (R&D)
objectives.desc: Speak with Anand Singhania in the cupping tasting room to uncover crop yields.
objectives.lesson: Bumper harvest yields lower cost of goods sold (COGS), expanding operating gross profit margins.

objectives.title: Interview Supply Chain Director Meera
objectives.desc: Speak with Meera Sen in the logistics department to inspect freight contracts.
objectives.lesson: Securing multi-year fixed maritime charter contracts hedges a company against spot freight inflation shocks.

objectives.title: Interview Commodities Buyer Rajiv
objectives.desc: Speak with Rajiv Patel at the procurement desk regarding international expansion.
objectives.lesson: Expanding supermarket distribution drives top-line revenue volume growth in high-growth emerging economies.

objectives.title: Inspect Financial Report & Product Display
objectives.desc: Examine the corporate ledger book on the executive boardroom desk.
objectives.lesson: Audited balance sheets confirm cash reserves, debt leverage ratios, and return on invested capital (ROIC).

objectives.title: Formulate Thesis in Journal [J]
objectives.desc: Open your Clue Journal [J], synthesize high conviction on CHAI, and trade on the BSE floor.
objectives.lesson: Combining R&D data, supply resilience, and audited financial statements creates an institutional-grade investment thesis.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The News Shock
chapters.subtitle: Market Events, Sentiment & Expectations
chapters.description: A breaking news wire impacts market sentiment. Investigate the newsroom, distinguish verified facts from rumor, observe sector reactions, and analyze how market expectations drive price response.

objectives.title: Read the Breaking News Wire
objectives.desc: Check your news feed [N] to review the breaking sector shock.
objectives.lesson: Breaking headlines trigger immediate algorithmic price adjustments. However, emotional first reactions often overshoot fair value.

objectives.title: Visit Reporter Priya Sharma
objectives.desc: Speak with financial investigative reporter Priya Sharma on Dalal Street.
objectives.lesson: Smart investors separate confirmed factual operational changes from speculative rumors and paid promotional spin.

objectives.title: Execute Strategic Portfolio Rebalance
objectives.desc: Enter BSE and adjust your portfolio positioning based on verified news intelligence.
objectives.lesson: Rebalancing aligns risk exposure to changing market realities rather than panic selling at local market bottoms.

objectives.title: Inspect Return Breakdown Panel
objectives.desc: Open the Stock Return Breakdown [B] to inspect news factor N(i,t) and decay.
objectives.lesson: News effects decay over time as information is fully absorbed into equity valuations.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Politics and Markets
chapters.subtitle: Fiscal Policy, Legislation & Macroeconomics
chapters.description: Enter the Parliament of India building. Study legislative bills, consult senior economic advisers on policy transmission, and learn why positive news can cause a sell-off if already anticipated.

objectives.title: Enter the Parliament Building
objectives.desc: Walk into the Parliament of India visitor and committee pavilion on Dalal Street.
objectives.lesson: Fiscal policy, national budgets, and tax legislation directly shape industry profitability.

objectives.title: Inspect Clean Energy Legislative Dossier
objectives.desc: Examine the green energy infrastructure bill on the parliamentary committee table.
objectives.lesson: Production-Linked Incentives (PLI) provide direct cash grants that drop straight to pre-tax earnings.

objectives.title: Consult Chief Adviser Dr. Subramanian
objectives.desc: Speak with senior economic adviser Dr. Subramanian about market pricing and policy anticipation.
objectives.lesson: 'Buy the rumor, sell the news' happens when markets price in an announcement in advance. If the bill offers less than expected, stocks fall.

objectives.title: Execute Policy-Informed Trade in AURA
objectives.desc: Return to BSE floor and purchase Aurum Clean Energy (AURA) based on parliamentary policy.
objectives.lesson: Government policy changes alter fundamental cost structures and grant long-term competitive moats.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Volatility Challenge
chapters.subtitle: Statistics, Risk Management & Diversification
chapters.description: Enter the Financial Research Library. Master standard deviation, compare high-beta tech with low-volatility consumer staples, practice position sizing, and construct a diversified portfolio.

objectives.title: Enter Financial Research Library
objectives.desc: Step inside the historic research library on Dalal Street.
objectives.lesson: Historical volatility measures the dispersion of returns around their mean over a rolling historical sample window.

objectives.title: Consult Library Director Eleanor Vance
objectives.desc: Speak with Chief Researcher Eleanor Vance regarding sample standard deviation and drawdown math.
objectives.lesson: Sample standard deviation sigma = sqrt(sum((r - mean)^2) / (n - 1)). High volatility means wider swings in both directions.

objectives.title: Inspect Quantitative Data Terminal
objectives.desc: Examine the archival trading terminal in the study carrel to review volatility distributions.
objectives.lesson: A streak of positive returns does not eliminate underlying volatility. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

objectives.title: Build a 3-Sector Diversified Portfolio
objectives.desc: Execute trades to hold active positions in at least 3 distinct market sectors simultaneously.
objectives.lesson: Diversification across uncorrelated asset classes reduces overall portfolio variance without sacrificing expected return.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Global Strategist
chapters.subtitle: International Markets & Master Investment Thesis
chapters.description: Unlock Wall Street NYSE, travel to New York, explore Apex Global Tower and Titan Banking Arcade, formulate your master investment thesis, and achieve the rank of Financial Titan.

objectives.title: Unlock Wall Street & Travel to New York
objectives.desc: Use the Global Travel Portal [M] to travel to Wall Street, New York.
objectives.lesson: Global arbitrage and cross-border portfolio allocation expand your opportunity set across differing economic cycles.

objectives.title: Enter the New York Stock Exchange Floor
objectives.desc: Walk up the neoclassical granite steps and enter the NYSE trading floor.
objectives.lesson: The NYSE trading floor operates designated market maker (DMM) posts to maintain orderly bid-ask spreads.

objectives.title: Visit Apex Tower & Interview CEO Vance
objectives.desc: Enter Apex Global Tower and interview CEO Sterling Vance in the executive suite.
objectives.lesson: Visionary executive leadership must be verified against capital expenditure burn rates and unit economic reality.

objectives.title: Submit Master Investment Thesis
objectives.desc: Open the Investment Thesis Screen [J] and record your multi-factor institutional allocation.
objectives.lesson: A rigorous thesis accounts for fundamentals, macro policy, event risks, volatility sizing, and margin of safety.

objectives.title: Execute Master Global Allocation
objectives.desc: Execute your master trade on the NYSE trading floor to reach Financial Titan status.
objectives.lesson: You have completed the MarketQuest Campaign! You have mastered financial fundamentals, news analysis, policy forecasting, and risk management. Post-campaign free roam unlocked across all global capitals!
